name: MA on Momentum Min Profit
summary: This EA trades based on momentum confirmation filtered by moving average direction. It opens positions when momentum indicators align with the trend defined by MA, and closes them when a minimum profit threshold is reached or momentum reverses. The strategy combines trend-following with momentum timing for entry and a profit-target-based exit mechanism.
summary_zh: 该EA基于动量确认并结合移动平均线方向过滤进行交易。当动量指标与MA定义的趋势方向一致时开仓，达到最低盈利目标或动量反转时平仓。策略结合了趋势跟踪与动量择时入场，以及基于盈利目标的出场机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是将移动平均线作为趋势方向过滤器，动量指标作为入场触发信号。入场条件要求价格位于MA上方时做多、位于MA下方时做空，同时动量指标必须确认趋势方向一致才会开仓。出场条件采用最低盈利目标机制，即持仓盈利达到设定阈值后平仓，同时也可能结合动量反转信号出场。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的简单计算方式，没有复杂的加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理方面依赖最低盈利目标来锁定利润，但缺少明确的止损机制来控制单笔最大亏损。整体策略逻辑清晰但风险控制较为薄弱，在剧烈行情中可能面临较大回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses a moving average as a trend direction filter and a momentum indicator as the entry trigger signal. Entry conditions require price to be above the MA for longs and below for shorts, with momentum confirmation aligning with the trend direction before opening a position. Exit conditions employ a minimum profit target mechanism, closing positions when the profit threshold is reached, and may also incorporate momentum reversal signals for exit. Position sizing uses fixed lots or a simple account-balance-based calculation without complex scaling or pyramiding logic. Money management relies on the minimum profit target to lock in gains, but lacks an explicit stop-loss mechanism to control maximum per-trade loss. Overall the strategy logic is clear but risk control is relatively weak, potentially facing significant drawdowns during volatile market conditions.

parameters.name: MA_Period
parameters.description: 移动平均线周期，用于判断趋势方向
parameters.description_en: Moving average period for trend direction

parameters.name: Min_Profit
parameters.description: 最低盈利目标（点数），达到后平仓
parameters.description_en: Minimum profit target in points to close

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points per level, 0 for none

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，MA过滤趋势方向配合动量确认入场，信号质量较高
最低盈利目标机制能在达到利润时及时锁定收益，避免利润回吐
双指标过滤减少了假信号，趋势与动量双重确认提高了胜率
参数较少，易于理解和调优，适合初学者使用
MA趋势过滤有效避免逆势交易，降低被套风险
pros_en: Clean and clear strategy logic with MA trend filter combined with momentum confirmation for higher signal quality
Minimum profit target mechanism locks in gains promptly when reached, preventing profit giveback
Dual indicator filtering reduces false signals, and trend-momentum double confirmation improves win rate
Few parameters make it easy to understand and optimize, suitable for beginners
MA trend filter effectively avoids counter-trend trades, reducing the risk of being trapped in wrong positions
cons: 缺少明确的止损机制，单笔交易亏损可能无限扩大，风险极高
最低盈利目标可能导致过早平仓，错过大趋势行情的利润空间
固定手数仓位管理没有根据账户波动率或风险比例动态调整
动量指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致反复亏损
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
cons_en: Lacks an explicit stop-loss mechanism, allowing per-trade losses to potentially grow indefinitely with extreme risk
Minimum profit target may cause premature exits, missing out on larger trend movement profits
Fixed lot position sizing does not dynamically adjust based on account volatility or risk proportion
Momentum indicator easily generates frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to repeated losses
No trading session filter, potentially executing trades during low-liquidity periods with unfavorable fills
improvements: 增加强制性止损机制，建议设置为ATR的倍数以适应市场波动性
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户风险比例和ATR自动计算手数
增加交易时段过滤和点差过滤，避免低流动性和高成本时段交易
improvements_en: Add a mandatory stop-loss mechanism, recommended as a multiple of ATR to adapt to market volatility
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lot size based on account risk ratio and ATR
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid low-liquidity and high-cost trading periods

risk_points: 缺少止损机制，单笔亏损无上限保护，极端行情可能爆仓
最低盈利目标平仓可能在浮盈较小时就退出，而亏损时无保护，盈亏比失衡
无交易频率限制和新K线检查，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
risk_points_en: No stop-loss mechanism means unlimited per-trade loss with no protection; extreme market moves could blow the account
Minimum profit target exits at small floating profit while losses have no cap, creating an asymmetric risk-reward imbalance
No trade frequency limit or new bar check could lead to repeated position opening on the same signal
